Study Plan Generator

Build a weekly study plan: enter subjects with weekly hours, pick your available days, and get a balanced day-by-day schedule.

Sessions are dealt round-robin across your days so the load stays balanced.

–
Hours / week
–
Sessions

📖 How to use

  1. Add your subjects with the hours per week each needs.
  2. Tick your available study days and set the session length.
  3. Press Build plan to get your day-by-day schedule.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the schedule built?

Each subject's weekly hours are split into sessions of your chosen length and dealt round-robin across your available days, so no day is overloaded.

Can I choose which days I study?

Yes — tick only the days you can study and all sessions land on those days.

How long should each session be?

Sessions default to 45 minutes with a short break, which you can change. Shorter, regular sessions beat marathon cramming.

Is this private?

Yes, everything is computed locally in your browser.
